medium.question: During the execution of 'Design & architectural pattern of Circular Dependency in Spring' within main(), how does the runtime manage memory and object references?
options: By maintaining distinct stack frames for method calls and allocating objects on the heap with proper reference management.
By permanently locking CPU cache lines and preventing any garbage collection pass.
By converting local variables into ThreadLocal singletons without lifecycle bounds.
By discarding return values and relying strictly on system standard out.
medium.explanation: Runtime execution for Circular Dependency in Spring relies on structured heap allocation, stack frames, and clean object scoping.
